effort_source: not settable: the harness leg has no per-spawn effort parameter, so this model binds no abstract level and is sent no reasoning parameter
context_limit_source: unknown, and unknown disables the overflow check for this model: nothing has measured the harness Opus window from inside this package and a number invented here would be a fact nobody established. `_overflows` treats a null limit as "never refuses", so a very large artifact on a draft pass is NOT caught by the pre-flight overflow check — it will fail at the spawn instead, where the turn is already spent. Fill this in once somebody knows it.
price_source: subscription — a spawn on this connector bills nothing per call, so the price is zero rather than unknown
prior_source: default — no measured run seats this model, and the projection prices it at zero either way
measured_output_price_source: the harness leg is not billed per token
